prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star desktop web portfolio comp, first viewport, landscape 16:9
Primary request: Design Costa Maskulov's bilingual creative full-stack developer portfolio in a "Development Darkroom" visual world: projects and decisions revealed through photographic test strips and controlled stages, translated into a modern web interface.
Structure: unmistakably a website. Top navigation: Costa Maskulov, Projets, À propos, FR / EN. Left region is a monumental condensed hero statement. Right region is one large SideQuest project proof with an explicit mock label and a readable process strip beneath it. A horizontal test strip organizes the routes Project, Profil, Compétences, Contact. Primary lime CTA is direct. Reveal enough of the next section at the fold.
Visual system: near-black and violet development room, cream photographic paper and labels, pink grease-pencil notes, lime active exposure marker. Use test-strip frames, registration marks, exposure scales and silver-paper depth, but keep the portfolio content dominant. One continuous reveal gesture implied, not many animated effects.
Typography: ultra-condensed display headline, clean sans-serif UI, one restrained italic serif accent.
Text (verbatim): "COSTA MASKULOV"; "DÉVELOPPEUR FULL-STACK CRÉATIF"; "RÉVÉLER DES EXPÉRIENCES WEB SINGULIÈRES"; "VOIR LES PROJETS"; "À PROPOS"; "SIDEQUEST"; "MOCK FICTIF — APPLICATION NON RÉALISÉE"; "PROJET"; "PROFIL"; "COMPÉTENCES"; "CONTACT"; "FR / EN".
Color palette: #101113 #4B3CFF #F5F1E8 #FF6BD6 #C7FF00.
Constraints: clearly a full-stack developer portfolio, not a photography service. SideQuest is unmistakably fictitious. Accessible contrast, visible focus affordances, no fake clients, results, repository, awards or deployment.
Avoid: sepia vintage nostalgia, generic photo portfolio, orange-only darkroom, gradients, glassmorphism, illegible handwritten copy, device mockup, poster-only layout, watermark.
